title: Adaptive recommendation A/B test for batching + prefix-caching with safe apply/rollback
creator: Priya Desai
description: Run a controlled A/B experiment that validates the cost and latency impact of the new adaptive recommendations engine (suggested batching parameters and prefix/KV-caching configs) and the safe apply/rollback automation. Goals: (1) measure cost savings per-1000-tokens without degrading P99 latency or error-rate; (2) validate canary rollout and automated rollback triggers; (3) surface clear dashboards and alerts for decisioning. This ticket scopes instrumentation, experiment buckets, significance tests, dashboard panels, and a pilot rollout on low-risk customer traffic. Acceptance criteria below.
acceptance_criteria: Experiment launched on 10% of production traffic with 1:1 randomization (control vs recommended-config)
Metric collection for token-cost, compute-ms-per-token, P50/P95/P99 latency, request error rate, model output quality (prompt-specific eval set) and tail KV cache hit rate
Statistical significance framework implemented (Bayesian A/B or frequentist with precomputed sample sizes) and automated snapshotting
Canary automation applies recommended config only for treatment cohort and will auto-rollback if predefined SLO regressions hit within canary window
Dashboards created in Console showing cost delta, latency SLOs, quality regressions, and automated rollback events with links to PR and runbook
Post-mortem template and experiment README added to Confluence with decision and next steps
experiment_design: Randomized A/B with session-sticky assignment. 10% treatment, 10% control out of production sample; rest untouched. Minimum run window 72 hours or until sample size hits precomputed N for P99 latency detection. Use stratified sampling by route (chat/generation/embeddings) and customer tier. Implement both live metrics (1m resolution) for fast detection and aggregated daily summaries for significance testing.
rollout_plan: Phase 1: Canary pilot on internal and opt-in dev customers (2 days). Phase 2: 10% production 72h. Automated safety checks run every 15m; if P99 increases by >20% absolute or error_rate increases by >0.5% absolute OR cost savings <0 then trigger rollback. Manual review owner: SRE on-call + experiment owner. Post-approval expand to 25% then 50% with same checks.

notes: Risk: quality regressions are possible when aggressive caching changes alter token prefixes. We must include prompt-level sampling and human review of diffs for top regression cases.
Mitigation: limit initial recommendation aggressiveness; run synthetic adversarial prompts through both arms during pilot.
